title: Zoom In
description: A lightweight zoom mod that lets you zoom in with a single keypress - no fluff, no dependencies beyond Fabric API.
body:
A lightweight zoom mod that lets you zoom in with a single keypress - no fluff, no dependencies beyond Fabric API.

## How to Use
- Press **Q** to zoom in *(rebindable in Controls > Keybinds)*
- Client command: `/zoom`
- Head to **Mod Menu** to customize all settings

## Options

**Zoom Transition** - Smooth or Instant

**Cinematic Camera** - Floaty and smooth, or off for snappy PvP use

**Spyglass Overlay** - Classic scope overlay while zoomed

**Spyglass Overlay Perspective Style** - First Person Only or All Perspectives

**Spyglass Sound** - Plays the spyglass use/stop sound on zoom

**Spyglass Stretched or Framed** - Toggles spyglass to default or Stretched view

## Commands
- `/zoom smooth` - toggle Smooth / Instant
- `/zoom cinematic` - toggle Cinematic Camera ON / OFF
- `/zoom overlay` - toggle Spyglass Overlay ON / OFF
- `/zoom style` - toggle Stretched / Framed
- `/zoom view` - toggle First Person Only / All Perspectives
- `/zoom sound` - toggle Spyglass Sound ON / OFF
- `/zoom settings` - print all current settings in chat
